What is our return policy?: Returns accepted within 30 days with receipt.
How do I reset my password?: Go to the login page, choose 'Forgot Password', and follow the emailed steps.
What are business hours?: We are open from 9 AM to 5 PM, Monday to Friday.
How do I submit an expense report?: Use the staff portal at https://expenses.company.com and upload receipts within 7 days.
How do I look up SEC filings?: Ask the assistant for 'Company Form' (example: 'Apple 10-K') after enabling network tools.
How do I submit a ticket?: Share a short summary of the issue. I can file a support ticket when ticket submission is configured.
How do I notify Slack?: Ask me to send a Slack message with the text. Slack posting needs a webhook configured on this deployment.
How do I start an SEC inquiry?: Provide the company, form type, and optional CIK. I will record the inquiry and return a Google Form link when configured.
How do I download a reference?: Send a public https:// link or an allowlisted s3:// location. Local files and private network addresses are refused.
How do I chat about filings?: First look up filings, select one from the list, then ask to chat about that filing after it is prepared.
What ticker format should I use?: Use a 1-5 letter stock ticker such as AAPL, or a company plus form like Apple 10-K.
How do I pick a company?: Type a ticker, or use the company picker in the web UI. I will then resolve matching SEC CIKs.
What is a CIK number?: A CIK is the SEC's 10-digit company identifier. After you share a ticker I list matching CIKs to choose from.
